name: SEIS desktop shell contract
purpose: One shared inspector contract for macOS, Windows, and Linux so the three desktop lanes stop diverging into separate apps: same views, same entities, same data contract, same icons. macOS already ships the reference implementation; Windows and Linux implement this same contract next (see docs/architecture/desktop-shell-unification.md).

data_contract.rule: Views consume the same entity shapes as the web cockpit and the macOS inspector; no per-OS-only state.

views.title: Branch Status
views.purpose: Canonical branch mirror and full-history source refs.

views.title: Plugin Status
views.purpose: Installed plugin counts and lane assignment.

views.title: Zip Audit
views.purpose: iCloud zip inventory status and the no-large-binaries gate.

views.title: Workspace
views.purpose: Drive docs and Calendar reviews opened in the browser.

views.title: Build Workbench
views.purpose: Cross-repo build order and per-module delivery status for the SEIS platform build-out.

views.title: Research Memory
views.purpose: Durable research notes captured under docs/research, indexed for quick recall.

windows.plan: Wrap the existing apps/web cockpit (already implements these four views against the same entities) in a native shell rather than writing a new UI from scratch.

linux.plan: Wrap the existing apps/web cockpit (already implements these four views against the same entities) in a native shell rather than writing a new UI from scratch.
linux.verification: Compiled and launched under Xvfb on Ubuntu 24.04 (see apps/desktop/native/README.md): the shell window opens loading apps/web/cockpit.html (an earlier revision defaulted to index.html instead, a real bug now fixed via tauri.windows[0].url), fully styled via the design-system CSS (staged alongside apps/web by stage-assets.mjs so cockpit.html's own ../../packages/... links resolve), with all six cockpit panels rendering their real embedded data. Screenshot-verified, not just log-verified. The contract's view taxonomy was reconciled with cockpit.html's six panels after this build was verified: build_workbench and research_memory were added as views (backed by new build_workbench/research_memory entities in apps/fullstack/state-model.json) alongside the original branch_status/plugin_status/zip_audit/workspace_links, so the six view_ids now map 1:1 onto cockpit.html's six panels (repository/plugins/build/workspace/security/research). This adds contract entries only; it does not re-verify the Linux build against the two new views beyond confirming cockpit.html already rendered their underlying data before the taxonomy gap was closed.

safety: No destructive actions (repo or archive deletion) are exposed in the UI; gates render read-only.
